items.title: Startups building on a model
items.body: Founders from the Minnebar and Twin Cities Startup Week crowd who need a first version people trust; MVP design takes 4 to 8 weeks.

items.title: B2B SaaS and software companies

items.title: Enterprise teams with AI pilots
items.body: Product groups inside large Twin Cities employers that built a proof of concept and need an interface staff will use.

items.title: AI product discovery workshop.

items.title: AI UX design.

outline.faqsRef: faqs[] below (put them in this inline section so the FAQ heading carries the keyword)

faqs.q: Does ui-ux.agency have an office in Minneapolis?
faqs.a: No. Our only office is in Reston, VA, and we work remotely with US teams in shared Figma files and video reviews. A Minneapolis project runs the same way. An on-site design sprint is possible; travel puts it at the upper end of the $12,000–$25,000 sprint range.

faqs.q: Can you run UX design research with our Minneapolis customers?
faqs.a: Yes. We interview your customers by video and run remote tests where 5 to 8 users complete real tasks in a prototype. Design sprints include recruiting 5 test users, so your Twin Cities customers can take part from their own desks.

faqs.q: Can a Minneapolis team hire a UX designer by the month?
faqs.a: Yes. A dedicated designer or team costs $15,000 to $40,000 per month and starts within 1 to 2 weeks of the scoping call. Every designer overlaps at least 4 hours with US Eastern time, which is one hour ahead of Minneapolis.

faqs.q: How quickly can a Minneapolis project start?
faqs.a: Most projects start 1 to 2 weeks after the first call. Send your brief on the contact page and a senior designer replies within one business day, Eastern Time (ET), with a few questions and times for a free consultation.

faqs.q: Do you design health tech software for Minnesota companies?
faqs.a: Yes. We design vertical SaaS for clinics and care teams, and Elia Wellness, a wellness learning app for adults over 50, grew registrations 40%. When screens show protected health information, the HIPAA Privacy Rule applies, so bring your compliance lead into design reviews.

faqs.q: Can your team also build the product?
faqs.a: Yes. ui-ux.agency is the design team of tkxel, and tkxel's engineering team builds the product when you need development as well as design. You can also hire us for design only and hand the files to your own engineers.
